name: Oliver Wyman
one_liner: Strategy consulting firm within Marsh, especially strong in financial services and risk, with broad industry practices.
at_a_glance: Business unit of Marsh (formerly Marsh McLennan), alongside Mercer and Guy Carpenter.
Signature strength in financial services and risk; also health, retail, transport, energy.
Integrated with Marsh's risk, insurance, and people businesses.

rounds: Screen: some offices use a short online numerical test.
First round: ~2 interviews, each with fit and case.
Final round: ~2-3 interviews; some offices include a written case with prep time and a presentation.
interview_process.case_style: Interactive, largely candidate-led; the firm frames the interviewer as your client who wants you to succeed. Cases are loosely based on real engagements.
interview_process.fit_style: Conversational interviews about your background, interests, and goals, and why Oliver Wyman.
interview_process.assessments: Office-dependent; some candidates take an online numerical reasoning test.

what_they_look_for: Ability to evaluate and apply data
culture: Collaborative style: 'think of the case interviewer as your client.'
Relatively flat, entrepreneurial feel with strong industry specialization.
why_us_angles: Does its financial services and risk depth connect to your finance or risk background?
Which Oliver Wyman practice (e.g., retail, transport) fits your industry experience?
How would working with Marsh's broader businesses shape the problems you could solve?
prep_tips: Practice collaborating with the interviewer as if they were a client.
Prepare for a written case with timed prep and presentation where offered.
Brush up on financial services and risk basics.
Ask about the online numerical test for your office.
